title: MAP Sensor Circuit
shortDescription: Manifold absolute pressure sensor signal out of range.
fullDescription:
On Ducati Marelli ECU, P0105 indicates MAP sensor signal fault. Twin-cylinder engines are sensitive to intake pressure pulses, so a faulty MAP causes rough running.

Common after tank lift work that disturbs sensor wiring.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Lift tank and check MAP harness routing.

whenToCallPro: If DDS tool needed for adaptation.
videoSearchQuery: Ducati motorcycle P0105 MAP sensor fix

title: ECT Sensor Circuit
fullDescription:
P0115 sets when ECT signal implausible. Ducati liquid-cooled models (Panigale, Multistrada) rely on ECT for fan and rich-start logic.

Dry-sump oil coolers don't affect this code on air-cooled models which use oil temp instead.

fixSteps.title: Replace ECT
fixSteps.instruction: Drain coolant, swap sensor, refill and bleed.

faq.a: Yes — run engine with cap open briefly.

title: TPS Circuit Fault
shortDescription: Throttle position sensor out of range.
fullDescription:
P0120 indicates TPS signal issue on Ducati ride-by-wire models. ECU enters limp with throttle capped.

DDS required for throttle relearn after service.

fixSteps.title: Replace throttle body
fixSteps.instruction: On V4/V2 the unit is non-serviceable.

fixSteps.title: DDS relearn
fixSteps.instruction: Dealer tool required for throttle calibration.

title: O2 Sensor Circuit
fullDescription:
P0130 indicates front cylinder O2 sensor circuit fault. Ducati L-twin mounts sensors in header collectors.

Frequent when owners fit aftermarket exhaust without retaining bungs.
videoSearchQuery: Ducati motorcycle P0130 O2 sensor fix

title: Injector Circuit
fullDescription:
P0200 is a generic injector circuit code. Ducati desmo engines use high-impedance injectors; failure usually in wiring or connector.

Drying with heat guns during winter fairing removal damages connectors.

title: Random Misfire
shortDescription: ECU detected misfires on multiple cylinders.
fullDescription:
P0300 is a random/multiple-cylinder misfire code. On L-twins misfires are very noticeable.

Check plugs, coils, fuel pressure, and desmo valve clearance (high-mileage).

fixSteps.title: Replace plugs
fixSteps.instruction: Install new iridium plugs per spec.

title: Crank Position Sensor Circuit
fullDescription:
P0335 indicates crank sensor issue. Engine may not start.

Often wiring damage at ignition trigger area under belt cover.
videoSearchQuery: Ducati motorcycle P0335 crank sensor fix

title: Cam Position Sensor Circuit
fullDescription:
P0340 indicates cam sensor fault. Ducati desmo engines require CMP for sequential injection.

Leaking belt cover can oil-foul sensor.

fixSteps.title: Clean oil
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe sensor and cover, fix leak source.

videoSearchQuery: Ducati motorcycle P0340 cam sensor fix

faq.a: If belts past service interval, check immediately.

title: Ignition Coil Primary Circuit
fullDescription:
P0350 sets when ECU sees coil primary fault. Ducati uses stick coils on each plug on modern engines.

Replace with OEM or Ducati-spec unit to avoid further MIL.

fixSteps.title: Remove shroud
fixSteps.instruction: Access coils under valve cover cap.

title: EVAP Pressure Sensor Range
shortDescription: Fuel vapor pressure sensor signal erratic.
fullDescription:
P0451 indicates EVAP system pressure sensor fault on US-market Ducati models. Affects emissions only.

Usually fuel cap seal or canister hose disconnect.

title: ECU Memory Checksum Error
fullDescription:
P0601 indicates ECU internal self-test detected memory corruption. Often occurs after voltage spike or botched flash.

Requires DDS tool or replacement ECU.

title: ECU Not Programmed
shortDescription: ECU is unprogrammed or not VIN-matched.
fullDescription:
P0602 means ECU is blank or VIN mismatch with immobilizer. Usually after ECU swap without dealer programming.

DDS required to pair ECU with VIN and immobilizer codes.

fixSteps.title: Dealer programming
fixSteps.instruction: Bring to Ducati dealer for ECU/VIN pairing.

videoSearchQuery: Ducati motorcycle P0602 ECU programming fix
